scope.independence: Previously inspected development scans; held out from each fit only; used to compare methods
scope.scanPosePolicy: Frozen historical affine, including scale/rotation/shear; three anchors per side; not current certification

blur.policy: PSF used in fitting only; fixed native scoring remains unblurred

border.policy: Shared white Alpha stock colors/rectangle; no per-card fitting. Corner match is to the common Scryfall PNG mask, not independently measured physical cuts.

maskedFrameResults.metric: Frame-only contrast/structure SSIM term x100; RGB MAE 8-bit; signed boundary gradient correlation x100

spectrum.method: Median 64px Hann-window spectra; diagnostic, not physical ink separation

artworkPolicy: Reference-derived extraction fidelity, not independent reconstruction accuracy
